thesis.core: Asset quality and provision coverage are improving, but the defensive-equity case is not yet strong: net interest margin is still compressing, core Tier-1 and total capital buffers are thin and declining, customer concentration has risen, and the bank approved zero 2025 cash dividend to preserve core capital.
thesis.variant_wedge: The headline low valuation is not enough by itself. Common-shareholder return, capital resilience and payout capacity are the binding variables.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use H1 ordinary BVPS RMB5.16 and normalized annual EPS around RMB0.34-0.36 as reference; value primarily on common P/B because sustainable ROE and capital generation dominate bank economics.

d2_answers.question: Test balance-sheet resilience, cash conversion and sustainable shareholder return.
d2_answers.fact: At 2026H1, NPL ratio improved to 1.68% from 1.71% and provision coverage rose to 193.61% from 185.81%. Core Tier-1 fell to 8.20% from 8.45%, total capital to 11.32% from 11.71%, while regulatory minima are 7.5% and 10.5%. NIM fell to 1.52% from 1.64%. The bank approved no 2025 cash dividend, retaining earnings to support core capital.
d2_answers.interpretation: Credit resilience is improving, but capital and shareholder-return resilience are not yet strong enough for a clean defensive label.

d2_answers.question: Compare the opportunity with lower-risk defensive and cash alternatives.
d2_answers.fact: Latest complete close was RMB1.81 and reported ordinary BVPS RMB5.16, about 0.35x common P/B. 2025 ordinary cash dividend was zero; 2024 paid RMB0.02/share.
d2_answers.interpretation: Low valuation gives asset-value cushion, but without current cash yield and with capital ratios declining, the equity does not clearly dominate lower-risk alternatives.

d2_answers.question: Normalize earnings and cash flow using latest primary financial disclosures.
d2_answers.fact: 2026H1 revenue RMB6.759bn (+1.04%), attributable net profit RMB1.677bn (+3.03%), interest net income +3.29%, non-interest income -7.96%, credit impairment expense +3.13%, annualized ROE 7.29%. Deposits +11.02% from year-end while loans +2.08%.
d2_answers.interpretation: Normalized earnings are stable rather than strongly improving; deposit growth strengthens funding but highlights asset-deployment and margin pressure.

d2_answers.question: Build an explicit valuation range and identify embedded expectations.
d2_answers.interpretation: Probability-weighted value is about RMB1.75, slightly below market; meaningful upside requires capital/NIM/payout improvement.

d2_answers.question: Define first-rejection test and invalidation evidence.
d2_answers.judgment: First rejection is triggered for D2 promotion: declining core capital ratios plus zero 2025 ordinary dividend mean normalized shareholder return does not support the intended DEFENSIVE_STABILITY label. Reopen if core capital and NIM stabilize with restored payout capacity or a sufficient price reset.
